Single source of truth for the multi-version Pages tree (issue #814). One entry per published leg. `id` names the build's artifact/subdir; `ref` is the git ref to build from (empty string means "whatever ref triggered the workflow", resolved to github.sha by the plan job); `subpath` is where it lands under https://dexaflow.dexadata.ai/ (empty = site root); `label` is the string shown in the version dropdown and written to params.version; `archived` marks a superseded GA so Docsy renders the archived-version banner.

Cutting a new GA release does this automatically: scripts/cut-release.sh calls promote_docs_version() after the tag is pushed, which repoints the `latest` entry's `ref` AND its `label` (the dropdown says `vX.Y.Z (latest)`, so a reader can tell which release they are on) and archives the GA it replaces, adding an entry for it if there is not one yet. The cut edits this file; hand-edit it only to recover a promotion the cut skipped, following the recipe in RELEASING.md. Before that was scripted, three GAs shipped with the root still built from v0.4.1: a procedure written in a comment that no script performs is a procedure that does not happen.
